name: v0-t-shirt-design-editor
description: A T-shirt design editor with AI integration

scripts.start: concurrently "npm run start:backend" "npm run start:backend:worker" "npm run start:frontend"
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:backend:worker" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.dev:infra: cd apps/api && (docker compose version >/dev/null 2>&1 && docker compose up -d || docker-compose up -d)
scripts.dev:infra:ha: cd apps/api && (docker compose version >/dev/null 2>&1 && docker compose -f docker-compose.ha.yml up -d || docker-compose -f docker-compose.ha.yml up -d)
scripts.dev:infra:ha:down: cd apps/api && (docker compose version >/dev/null 2>&1 && docker compose -f docker-compose.ha.yml down || docker-compose -f docker-compose.ha.yml down)
scripts.dev:infra:deps-ha: cd apps/api && (docker compose version >/dev/null 2>&1 && docker compose -f docker-compose.deps-ha.yml up -d || docker-compose -f docker-compose.deps-ha.yml up -d)
scripts.dev:infra:deps-ha:down: cd apps/api && (docker compose version >/dev/null 2>&1 && docker compose -f docker-compose.deps-ha.yml down || docker-compose -f docker-compose.deps-ha.yml down)
scripts.dev:infra:redis-only: docker ps --format '{{.Names}}' | grep -q '^tshirt-redis$' || (docker ps -a --format '{{.Names}}' | grep -q '^tshirt-redis$' && docker start tshirt-redis || docker run -d --name tshirt-redis -p 6379:6379 redis:7-alpine redis-server --appendonly yes)
scripts.dev:full: npm run dev:infra && concurrently -k -n comfyui,app -c magenta,cyan "cd services/comfyui && python main.py --listen 0.0.0.0 --port 8188" "npm run dev"
scripts.dev:full:comfyui-env: npm run dev:infra && concurrently -k -n comfyui,app -c magenta,cyan "/usrhome/junrong/miniconda3/bin/conda run -p /usrhome/junrong/miniconda3/envs/comfyui python ComfyUI/main.py --listen 0.0.0.0 --port 8188" "npm run dev"
scripts.dev:full:comfyui-env:external-mq: npm run dev:infra:redis-only && concurrently -k -n comfyui,app -c magenta,cyan "/usrhome/junrong/miniconda3/bin/conda run -p /usrhome/junrong/miniconda3/envs/comfyui python ComfyUI/main.py --listen 0.0.0.0 --port 8188" "npm run dev"
scripts.dev:full:stop: cd apps/api && (docker compose version >/dev/null 2>&1 && docker compose down || docker-compose down)
scripts.dev:backend: cd apps/api && PORT=8185 npm run dev:safe
scripts.build: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend
scripts.verify:functional: npm run build && npm run release:db:check && npm run test
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd apps/web && npm install && cd ../apps/api && npm install
scripts.clean: cd apps/web && npm run clean; cd ../apps/api && npm run clean
scripts.test: cd apps/web && npm run test --if-present && cd ../apps/api && npm run test --if-present
scripts.start:backend: cd apps/api && PORT=8185 npm run start:safe

author: yeesiang03
